services.name: Tandem Flights
services.desc: Experience the magic of flight and the thrill of gliding effortlessly through the skies. At SkyBrothers, we offer tandem paragliding adventures that take you up to 2,500 feet, flying side-by-side with an expert pilot. With the help of a winch mounted on our truck, you’ll launch smoothly into the air and, once released, enjoy the pure serenity of non-powered flight as your pilot navigates you back to the landing site for a soft, safe touchdown. Each flight lasts 20-30 minutes, offering breathtaking views and unforgettable memories. No prior experience is needed-just assist with a quick, 5-step run to launch. For couples or groups, book consecutive time slots, and we’ll fly each participant
